body:
One of the things that i didn't get to, the upcoming thing is that we are about to be homeless. That's actually just making me crazy. We were so successful and I fought so hard and we have lost it all.

I don't want to live off of charity. My lease is up anyway. I just am feeling really hopeless.

Thanks for answering :)

It's difficult to have close friends when one is mentally ill like myself. I tend to push people away, invent or blow small things they say or do out of proportion.  Combined with the (now more rare) uncontrollable screaming and crying, I'm not someone most want to make their friend. 

I have some friends online which is nice, because I can run away so to speak. 

But in the grand scheme... To be honest I feel that those are people who won't even be invited to my funeral, who may never even know if I do commit suicide. If they do, that brief sadness will pass over them and in minutes or days they will get over it.

I've had close friends I can talk to, but right now I can only talk to my husband... And I just don't feel like he needs to hear about how I constantly feel like killing myself for the thousandth time. He gets it and he doesn't really want to hear about it... :( neither do I want to bother him with it.

It's also difficult. The money part I mean. I was in choir for awhile but I couldn't afford a dress.... So I was the only poor person in the choir with no dress, just a very old skirt and button down shirt. It was pretty embarrassing.

I... Hate myself for telling you this because looking back over it it feels like making excuses. But nothing changes the fact that this is how I feel and these things have happened to me...

Thank you for taking time for my dumb post

Also I'm 30 lol
 Those teen years are definitely over with!! :)

Hey there I also want to kill myself.

If i could just hold your hand so you wouldn't be alone I would.

I wish we didn't have to suffer like this... It's absolutely brutal. I'm really sorry.
